---
metadata-files: [_title-meta.yml]
format: mcanouil-html
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The gold HTML document has the title block, the corner motif, the landmarks, the skip link and both schemes.
        check: bash _checks/html.sh title gold
    mcanouil-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<header id="title-block-header"[^>]*mc-title-block', '<meta name="mcanouil-preset" content="gold">']
        - ['fonts.googleapis.com', 'fonts.gstatic.com']
---

{{< include _title.qmd >}}
